summary: Composite risk reads 46.31 and stays in caution, the regime is still classified goldilocks, and trend_1d and trend_1w both print 0.0 — the score has not moved. The defining input is a self-contradictory labour report: payems came in at -23.0 against a prior 20.0, yet unrate fell to 4.1 from 4.2 while civpart slipped to 61.4 from 61.5 and ccsa rose to 1801000 from 1777000, so the friendlier headline rests on a shrinking workforce rather than stronger hiring. Risk assets read the soft print as draining the pressure for a further hike — FedWatch still shows hold, with an implied rate of 3.685 against an effective 3.63 — and the most recent completed session was broadly risk-on: AI Software +6.0538%, Quantum Computing +5.7226% and Consumer Electronics +5.3946% led, while NVDA added 2.2695% to close a 11.5616% week. Two caveats bite. Cross-asset confirmation sits at just 0.5 yet is the single largest risk contributor at 8.8235, so the advance lacks corroboration outside equities. And the volatility dimension is blind — coverage 0.00, effective weight 0.0 — so its 15.0 weight is redistributed and the model neither rewards nor penalises a VIX that eased to 15.15 from 15.81. Into the new week the inflation data are the pivot, while the revived attempt to remove Fed Governor Lisa Cook layers an institutional risk on top.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation is the largest single contributor to the composite at 8.8235, while the underlying reading is only 0.5 — equity strength is not being corroborated by bonds, credit and FX. The input is a proxy carrying a 0.8 discount, so read the level as directional rather than precise.

The 10Y real rate at 2.43 sits in the 99.04 percentile of its history and contributes 5.8259 — the most expensive single piece of the macro backdrop, and the reason the macro dimension scores 65.38, the highest of the six.

The nominal 10Y yield at 4.69 is in the 98.0 percentile and adds 5.6465. Together with dgs2 at 4.25 the curve holds a positive 0.44, so the pressure shows up as an absolute level of funding cost rather than as an inversion signal.

Reverse repo has fallen to 1.45, the 7.38 percentile, contributing 4.0113. The overnight liquidity buffer that absorbed shocks through the tightening cycle is close to exhausted, which raises the market's sensitivity to any funding stress.

Leadership is thin: only 0.1067 of the sample is at new highs, contributing 2.837, even though 0.6867 of names hold above their MA200. Broad participation with few genuine breakouts is a structure that inverts quickly once the leaders stall.

supporting_signals.claim: The labour internals corroborate caution rather than the headline. payems at -23.0 is an outright contraction against a prior 20.0, ccsa has risen to 1801000 from 1777000, and civpart has slipped to 61.4 from 61.5 — the drop in unrate to 4.1 from 4.2 is therefore flattered by people leaving the workforce.

Memory is the one theme that broke ranks, at -2.202 against a tape where almost everything else rose, and MU closed -0.4424. Fresh capacity announcements in the memory supply chain are the visible driver, which makes this an industry supply story rather than a demand warning.

The confidence factors show the weak link is consistency at 0.6029, well below data_quality at 1.0 and coverage at 0.78. The composite confidence of 0.8326 is therefore carried by clean data rather than by signals that agree with one another.

The volatility dimension contributes nothing at all: coverage 0.00 and effective weight 0.0 mean its nominal 15.0 weight is redistributed across the other five dimensions. Any composite move right now is as much a weighting artefact as a risk signal.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit is not confirming any stress. HY OAS at 2.71 sits in the 10.29 percentile and IG OAS at 0.78 in the 17.43 percentile, both near the calm end of their ranges, and HY has tightened from 2.75.
Trend inputs are outright constructive: drawdown_52w is 0.0, meaning the index is at its high, price_vs_ma200 is 9.9989 and momentum_3m is 5.6973. Nothing in the price structure is breaking.

Inflation expectations are drifting lower, not higher: t5yifr eased to 2.28 and t10yie to 2.25, while realised cpilfesl is 2.56579 and pcepilfe 3.28653, both below their prior readings. That is the opposite of what a hiking scare needs.

Damage is not spreading through the tape. new_lows_ratio is only 0.0133, small_cap_relative is 1.1404 and semis_relative is 4.6427, so the appetite that lifted AI Infrastructure 2.4449% and Semiconductor Equipment 3.5532% is not being offset by breakdowns elsewhere.

what_changed_today: All seven datasets report fresh this run — macro, equities, crypto, news, calendar, sectors and risk — the first fully clean input set in recent runs, and model confidence lifted to 0.8326.
The composite itself did not move: trend_1d and trend_1w are both 0.0, with the score at 46.31.

The labour report inverted the policy debate — payems printed -23.0 versus a prior 20.0, and the market now leans away from a further hike even though the implied rate of 3.685 still sits above the effective 3.63.
VIX eased to 15.15 from 15.81 while the volatility dimension stayed uncounted at 0.0 effective weight.
Memory split from the rest of tech at -2.202 while the mainland memory and packaging chain printed strong gains, with GigaDevice up 8.3247% and Longsys up 5.5333%.
The removal proceeding against a sitting Fed governor was restarted, putting central-bank independence back into the risk set.
watch_next: The consumer price report is the first high-importance macro release of the coming week and the direct test of the claim that core inflation is heading to a multi-year low.
Producer prices and retail sales follow inside the same week and together complete the inflation plus demand picture the Fed says it needs.
Whether cross-asset confirmation lifts off 0.5 — until bonds, credit and FX agree with equities, the largest contributor at 8.8235 stays a drag.
Whether VIX data returns to the volatility dimension. While coverage stays at 0.00 the composite carries an unmeasured 15.0 weight and every score move is partly mechanical.
Memory pricing after the -2.202 session — whether new fab capacity plans keep compressing the theme, or the supply story is already discounted.
The legal path of the Fed governor removal attempt, the clearest channel from politics into the rates curve.

bull_case.title: Bull case: disinflation is confirmed and the hike premium unwinds
points: A soft core inflation print validates breakevens already at 2.28 and 2.25 and pulls the implied rate of 3.685 back toward the effective 3.63, relieving a macro dimension currently at 65.38.
With drawdown_52w at 0.0 and momentum_3m at 5.6973, lower rates let leadership broaden out from the 0.1067 new-highs ratio instead of concentrating further.

base_case.title: Base case: caution persists and the composite stays range-bound
points: The score holds near 46.31 with the goldilocks label intact while HY OAS stays near 2.71 and breadth holds above 0.6867 — calm credit caps the downside, weak cross-asset confirmation at 0.5 caps the upside.
Rates stay high but stable, with dgs10 around 4.69 and the real rate around 2.43, so the macro dimension remains the top scorer without turning into an acute shock.

bear_case.title: Bear case: rates re-accelerate and thin leadership snaps
points: A hot inflation print pushes dgs10 above 4.69 and the real rate above 2.43, re-rating a macro dimension already scoring 65.38 and dragging the composite off its 46.31 anchor.
With only 0.1067 of the sample at new highs, a stall in the leaders drags breadth down from 0.6867 and lifts new_lows_ratio from 0.0133, turning a narrow advance into a broad drawdown.
An adverse turn in the Fed governor dispute adds a credibility premium to the curve at a moment when cross-asset confirmation is already only 0.5.
